parts.zh: W: 嗨，我叫凯茜。很高兴认识你！
M: 我也很高兴认识你
W: 我是布伦达的同事
M: 哦，对，所以你就是办公室里的凯茜
W: 哦，他确实是。我的意思是
M: 嗯，我大学毕业后有一段时间从事广告工作
W: 听起来棒极了，而且你真是有心
M: 今晚聚会上的这些饼干是你烤的吗？
W: 是的，我是在杂志上看到这个点子的
M: 它们很好吃。你完全不用担心
W: 你真的这么认为吗？

items.stem: What did Cathy and Brenda finish doing last week?

choices.text: A six-month-long negotiation.
choices.zh: 一场为期六个月的谈判。

choices.text: Preparations for the party.
choices.zh: 聚会的准备工作。

choices.text: A project with a troublesome client.
choices.zh: 一个麻烦客户的项目。

choices.text: Gift wrapping for the colleagues.
choices.zh: 给同事们包装礼物。

items.stem: What is John going to do for Brenda?

choices.text: Take wedding photos.
choices.zh: 拍摄婚礼照片。

choices.text: Advertise her company.
choices.zh: 为她的公司做广告。

choices.text: Start a small business.
choices.zh: 创办一家小企业。

choices.text: Throw a celebration party.
choices.zh: 举办一场庆祝聚会。

items.stem: How did Cathy feel when asked to bake the cake?

choices.text: Hesitant.
choices.zh: 犹豫的。

choices.text: Nervous.
choices.zh: 紧张的。

choices.text: Flattered.
choices.zh: 受宠若惊的。

choices.text: Surprised.
choices.zh: 惊讶的。

items.stem: What does the man suggest the woman do?

choices.text: Start her own bakery.
choices.zh: 开办她自己的面包店。

choices.text: Improve her baking skill.
choices.zh: 提高她的烘焙技能。

choices.text: Share her cooking experience.
choices.zh: 分享她的烹饪经验。

choices.text: Prepare for the wedding
choices.zh: 为婚礼做准备。

items.stem: What does the man say about college students as compared with high schoolers?

choices.text: They have to spend more time studying.
choices.zh: 他们必须花更多时间学习。

choices.text: They have to participate in club activities.
choices.zh: 他们必须参加社团活动。

choices.text: They have to be more responsible for what they do.
choices.zh: 他们必须对自己的行为更加负责。

choices.text: They have to choose a specific academic discipline.
choices.zh: 他们必须选择一个具体的学术学科。

items.stem: What are college students expected to do according to the man?

choices.text: Get ready for a career.
choices.zh: 为职业生涯做好准备。

choices.text: Make a lot of friends.
choices.zh: 结交很多朋友。

choices.text: Set a long-term goal.
choices.zh: 设定一个长远目标。

choices.text: Behave like adults.
choices.zh: 表现得像成年人一样。

items.stem: What kind of friends does the man suggest the woman make as a college student?

choices.text: Those who share her academic interests.
choices.zh: 那些与她有共同学术兴趣的人。

choices.text: Those who respect her student commitments.
choices.zh: 那些尊重她学业责任的人。

choices.text: Those who can help her when she is in need.
choices.zh: 那些能在她需要时帮助她的人。

choices.text: Those who go to the same clubs as she does.
choices.zh: 那些和她去同样社团的人。

items.stem: What kind of club activities should college students engage in according to the man?

choices.text: Those helpful for tapping their potential.
choices.zh: 那些有助于发掘他们潜力的活动。

choices.text: Those conducive to improving their social skills.
choices.zh: 那些有利于提高他们社交技能的活动。

choices.text: Those helpful for cultivating individual interests.
choices.zh: 那些有助于培养个人兴趣的活动。

choices.text: Those conducive to their academic studies.
choices.zh: 那些有利于他们学业的活动。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about most successful people?

choices.text: They break away from traditional ways of thinking.
choices.zh: 他们打破了传统的思维方式。

choices.text: They are prepared to work harder than anyone else.
choices.zh: 他们准备比任何人都更加努力地工作。

choices.text: They are good at refining old formulas.
choices.zh: 他们善于改进旧有的方法。

choices.text: They bring their potential into full play.
choices.zh: 他们充分发挥了自己的潜能。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about Killy's experiments?

choices.text: They contributed to the popularity of skiing worldwide.
choices.zh: 它们促进了滑雪运动在全世界的普及。

choices.text: They resulted in a brand-new style of skiing techniques.
choices.zh: 它们产生了一种全新的滑雪技术风格。

choices.text: They promoted the scientific use of skiing poles.
choices.zh: 它们推动了滑雪杖的科学使用。

choices.text: They made explosive news in the sports world.
choices.zh: 它们在体育界引起了爆炸性新闻。

items.stem: What is said to be Killy's biggest honor in his skiing career?

choices.text: He was recognized as a genius in the world of sports.
choices.zh: 他被公认为体育界的天才。

choices.text: He competed in all major skiing events in the world.
choices.zh: 他参加了世界上所有主要的滑雪赛事。

choices.text: He won three gold medals in one Winter Olympics.
choices.zh: 他在一届冬季奥运会上赢得了三枚金牌。

choices.text: He broke three world skiing records in three years.
choices.zh: 他在三年内打破了三项世界滑雪纪录。

items.stem: What happens to guinea pigs, when blood samples of angry people are injected into them?

choices.text: They appear restless.
choices.zh: 它们显得焦躁不安。

choices.text: They lose consciousness.
choices.zh: 它们失去意识。

choices.text: They become upset.
choices.zh: 它们变得烦躁。

choices.text: They die almost instantly.
choices.zh: 它们几乎立即死亡。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about every thought you have?

choices.text: It has an instant effect on your body chemistry.
choices.zh: 它对你的身体化学反应有即时影响。

choices.text: It keeps returning to you every now and then.
choices.zh: 它时不时地再次出现在你脑海中。

choices.text: It leaves you with a long lasting impression.
choices.zh: 它给你留下持久的印象。

choices.text: It contributes to the shaping of your mind.
choices.zh: 它有助于塑造你的思维。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about every thought you have?

choices.text: To succeed while feeling irritated.
choices.zh: 在感到恼怒的同时取得成功。

choices.text: To feel happy without good health.
choices.zh: 在没有良好健康的情况下感到快乐。

choices.text: To be free from frustration and failure.
choices.zh: 摆脱挫折和失败。

choices.text: To enjoy good health while in dark moods.
choices.zh: 在阴郁情绪中享有良好健康。

items.stem: What does the passage say about our mind and body?

choices.text: They are closely connected.
choices.zh: 它们紧密相连。

choices.text: They function in a similar way.
choices.zh: 它们以相似的方式运作。

choices.text: They are too complex to understand.
choices.zh: 它们过于复杂而难以理解。

choices.text: They are too complex to understand.
choices.zh: 它们过于复杂而难以理解。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about beginners and expert pianists?

choices.text: They differ in their appreciation of music.
choices.zh: 他们对音乐的欣赏不同。

choices.text: They focus their attention on different things.
choices.zh: 他们关注的事物不同。

choices.text: They finger the piano keys in different ways.
choices.zh: 他们按琴键的方式不同。

choices.text: They choose different pieces of music to play.
choices.zh: 他们选择演奏不同的曲目。

items.stem: What do smart basketball players do according to the speaker?

choices.text: They manage to cooperate well with their teammates.
choices.zh: 他们设法与队友良好合作。

choices.text: They use effective tactics to defeat their competitors.
choices.zh: 他们使用有效的战术击败竞争对手。

choices.text: They try hard to meet the spectators' expectations.
choices.zh: 他们努力满足观众的期望。

choices.text: They attach great importance to high performance.
choices.zh: 他们非常重视高水平表现。

items.stem: What do we learn about the new study published in an online video?

choices.text: It marks a breakthrough in behavioral science.
choices.zh: 它标志着行为科学的突破。

choices.text: It adopts a conventional approach to research.
choices.zh: 它采用传统的研究方法。

choices.text: It supports a piece of conventional wisdom.
choices.zh: 它支持一条传统智慧。

choices.text: It gives rise to controversy among experts.
choices.zh: 它在专家中引起争议。

items.stem: What overwhelms the speaker when she buys her summer outfits each year?

choices.text: People's envy of slim models.
choices.zh: 人们对苗条模特的羡慕。

choices.text: People's craze for good health.
choices.zh: 人们对健康的狂热追求。

choices.text: The increasing range of fancy products.
choices.zh: 花哨产品的种类日益增多。

choices.text: The great variety of slimming products.
choices.zh: 减肥产品的种类繁多。

items.stem: What does the speaker think of girls wrapping their legs up with slimming tape?

choices.text: They appear vigorous.
choices.zh: 她们显得精力充沛。

choices.text: They appear strange.
choices.zh: 她们显得奇怪。

choices.text: They look charming.
choices.zh: 她们看起来很有魅力。

choices.text: They look unhealthy.
choices.zh: 她们看起来不健康。

items.stem: What does the speaker think affects people's interpretation of beauty?

choices.text: Culture and upbringing.
choices.zh: 文化和教养。

choices.text: Wealth and social status.
choices.zh: 财富和社会地位。

choices.text: Peer pressure.
choices.zh: 同伴压力。

choices.text: Media influence.
choices.zh: 媒体影响。

items.stem: What does the speaker mainly talk about?

choices.text: The relation between hair and skin.
choices.zh: 毛发与皮肤的关系。

choices.text: The growing interest in skin studies.
choices.zh: 对皮肤研究日益增长的兴趣。

choices.text: The color of human skin.
choices.zh: 人类皮肤的颜色。

choices.text: The need of skin protection.
choices.zh: 皮肤保护的需要。

items.stem: What had probably caused humans to lose most of their hair one and a half million years ago?

choices.text: The necessity to save energy.
choices.zh: 节省能量的必要性。

choices.text: Adaptation to the hot environment.
choices.zh: 对炎热环境的适应。

choices.text: The need to breathe with ease.
choices.zh: 轻松呼吸的需要。

choices.text: Dramatic climate changes on earth.
choices.zh: 地球上剧烈的气候变化。

items.stem: What does the speaker say protected early humans from the sun?

choices.text: Leaves and grass.
choices.zh: 树叶和草。

choices.text: Man-made shelter.
choices.zh: 人造庇护所。

choices.text: Their skin coloring.
choices.zh: 他们的皮肤颜色。

choices.text: Hair on their skin.
choices.zh: 他们皮肤上的毛发。

items.stem: What happened after humans migrated from Africa to other parts of the world?

choices.text: Their genetic makeup began to change.
choices.zh: 他们的基因构成开始改变。

choices.text: Their communities began to grow steadily.
choices.zh: 他们的群落开始稳步增长。

choices.text: Their children began to mix with each other.
choices.zh: 他们的孩子开始相互混合。

choices.text: Their pace of evolution began to quicken.
choices.zh: 他们的进化速度开始加快。
